title: Enablement playset: Graceful fallback & latency-aware routing (Sales + CS quick playbook)
creator: Ava Chen
description: Goal: Deliver a concise, battle-tested Sales & Customer Success enablement pack for the upcoming Graceful Fallback & Latency-Aware Routing feature. The pack should let sellers and CS rapidly surface value, demo common customer scenarios, and troubleshoot customer-reported latency/fallback incidents. Scope includes: battlecard (one-pager + talking points), FAQ, persona-specific talk tracks (Startup, PLG, Enterprise), two demo scripts (quick 3-min demo + 10-min deep dive), a short troubleshooting runbook for CS, objection handling matrix, and a one-slide ROI spinner for sales decks. Coordinate asset approvals with Engineering (behavioural guarantees), Design (brand/visuals), and Support (CS playbook).
acceptance_criteria: Finalized battlecard PDF uploaded to Drive and referenced in the playbook
Demo scripts validated with 1x eng-runthrough and 1x sales dry-run
FAQ covers at least 12 expected questions including SLO, data residency, and cost implications
CS troubleshooting runbook aligned with Support runbooks and linked to incident postmortem template
All assets approved by PM, Design, and Eng and published to the enablement hub
notes: This is a high-priority field-facing launch asset. Keep language prescriptive and include redlines for when to escalate to engineering. Avoid deep implementation detail in battlecard — point to docs/PR for technical owners.
